_: Verbatim Judge.me reviews for LGH01 Stryker. Real submissions only.
_complete: All 20 — one widget page covers the set. Mean is 4.60 -> 4.6, matching the rating Shopify reports, so the histogram is exact rather than sampled.
_note: Two themes worth knowing before reading the score: the single 1-star is a one-word complaint that there was no left-hand option, which the product now has, and the two sub-5 reviews that discuss play both flag the SHAFT as soft or twisty. That is the only recurring criticism of this club and the page offers one flex.
